scripts.clusterize: cat ./scripts/1.join-cluster.sh | docker exec -i rabbitmq2 sh && cat ./scripts/1.join-cluster.sh | docker exec -i rabbitmq3 sh
scripts.setup-shovel: cat ./scripts/3.add-shovel-external.sh | docker exec -i rabbitmq-external sh && dotenv -e ./external-publisher/.env -- envsubst < ./scripts/4.add-shovel-cluster.sh | docker exec -i rabbitmq1 sh
scripts.backup:schema:rabbitmq-external: docker exec -i rabbitmq-external sh -c 'rabbitmqadmin -u rmuser -p rmpassword export var/lib/rabbitmq/schema.json'
scripts.backup:schema:rabbitmq-cluster: docker exec -i rabbitmq1 sh -c 'rabbitmqadmin -u rmuser -p rmpassword export var/lib/rabbitmq/schema.json'
scripts.docker: docker-compose up -d && sleep 15 && npm run clusterize && npm run setup-shovel && docker-compose -f ./external-publisher/docker-compose.yml up
scripts.clean: npm run clean:containers && npm run clean:volumes
scripts.clean:containers: docker rm rabbitmq1 -f && docker rm rabbitmq2 -f && docker rm rabbitmq3 -f && docker rm rabbitmq-external -f
scripts.clean:volumes: sudo rm -rf ./rabbitmq-1 && sudo rm -rf ./rabbitmq-2 && sudo rm -rf ./rabbitmq-3 && sudo rm -rf ./rabbitmq-external
